item.title: Leaf Reader 1.7.5
item.description:
• 新增阅读笔记 Markdown、HTML、PDF 导出，并支持只导出收藏笔记。
  • 改进 PDF 朗读分段匹配和当前句子高亮定位。
  • 修复 PDF 断行连字符单词，例如 Nine-tenths 的保存、查询和高亮。
  • 收窄 PDF 单词下划线范围，避免生成过长高亮线。

• Added Reading Notes export options for Markdown, HTML, and PDF, including favorite-only exports.
  • Improved PDF read-aloud segment matching and current sentence highlighting.
  • Fixed line-broken hyphenated vocabulary words such as Nine-tenths in PDF selections.
  • Tightened PDF vocabulary underline bounds to avoid overly long highlights.
